'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2023 Hamas-led attack on Israel]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] confirms the death of Bilha Yinon, the last person missing in [[Israel]] following the attack by [[Hamas]] on October 7, 2023. [https://www.newsweek.com/bilha-yinon-dead-israel-attacks-hamas-1935669 (''Newsweek'')]

***Six [[Palestinian]]s are killed in an [[Israel]]i raid on the [[Maghazi refugee camp]] and in [[Khan Younis]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.saba.ye/en/news3355224.htm (Saba News Agency)] [https://aje.io/5hzx8h?update=3104121 (Al Jazeera)]

**[[Egypt]] and the [[United Kingdom]] issue [[NOTAM]] alerts and order their airlines to avoid [[Iran|Iranian]] and [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] airspaces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/egypt-asks-its-airlines-avoid-iran-air-space-three-hours-thursday-2024-08-07/ (Reuters)]
** Three killed and ten injured in Israeli airstrikes on [[Jwaya]], Lebanon. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/7/israel-war-on-gaza-live-concentrated-bombing-attacks-target-central-gaza/ (Al Jazeera)]

*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
***[[Russia]]n Chief of General Staff [[Valery Gerasimov]] says that the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] advance into [[Kursk Oblast]] has been stopped as reports emerge of continued heavy fighting in the vicinity of [[Sudzha]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2n9y4nm3lo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Thirty people are killed, five are missing and hundreds are displaced after days of [[flood]]s in [[Hodeidah]] and [[Hajjah]], [[Yemen]]. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-flood-cb6a0bf0fae0093f7129456e7a30ae57 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Deforestation of the Amazon Rainforest]]
**The [[Government of Brazil]] reports that [[deforestation]] in the [[Amazon Rainforest]] is at its lowest level since 2016. [https://apnews.com/article/amazon-deforestation-marina-silva-rainforest-climate-cerrado-77079e3beaf5d39aebcc8ac93fa66d97 (AP)]
*[[Environmental threats to the Great Barrier Reef]]
**The water temperature around the [[Great Barrier Reef]] is reported to have reached a 400-year record high, which is causing more [[coral bleaching|mass bleaching]] events. [https://www.dw.com/en/australia-great-barrier-reef-waters-warmest-in-400-years/a-69881611 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Thai general election]]
**[[Lèse-majesté in Thailand]]
***The [[Constitutional Court of Thailand|Constitutional Court]] of [[Thailand]] orders the dissolution of the [[Move Forward Party]], which won the most seats and votes in last year's election, but was blocked from forming a government, over the party's campaigning on Lèse-majesté decriminalization. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crkmdd4vevxo (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/7/thai-constitutional-court-dissolves-progressive-move-forward-party (Al Jazeera)]
*[[End Bad Governance protests]]
**[[Nigeria]] arrests seven [[Poland|Polish]] nationals for raising [[Flag of Russia|Russian flags]] during anti-government protests this week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-arrests-seven-polish-nationals-raising-russian-flags-protests-2024-08-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Africa's genocide case against Israel]]
**[[Turkey]] submits a bid to join [[South Africa]]'s side in the [[International Court of Justice]] case against [[Israel]]'s conduct in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/7/turkey-submits-icj-bid-to-join-south-africas-genocide-case-against-israel (Al Jazeera)]
*Police in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], arrest a [[palliative care]] nurse for allegedly killing four elderly patients. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-police-arrest-doctor-for-allegedly-killing-4-patients/a-69878099 (DW)]
*[[Russian Americans|Russian-American]] [[Ksenia Karelina]] pleads guilty in a [[Russia]]n court to a charge of [[treason]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/07/europe/ksenia-karelina-russian-american-treason-guilt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 Vienna terrorism plot]]
**Police in [[Austria]] arrest two men affiliated with the [[Islamic State]] for allegedly planning to commit a [[terrorist attack]] at [[United States|American]] singer [[Taylor Swift]]'s upcoming [[The Eras Tour|concerts]] at the [[Ernst-Happel-Stadion]] in [[Vienna]], which are subsequently cancelled. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/07/two-arrested-suspected-of-planning-attack-on-taylor-swifts-vienna-concerts (''The Guardian'')]

**[[Missouri's 1st congressional district|Missouri]] [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] congresswoman [[Cori Bush]] loses her [[Partisan primary|primary election]] to [[St. Louis County, Missouri|St. Louis County]] [[district attorney|prosecutor]] [[Wesley Bell]], becoming the second member of [[The Squad (United States Congress)|the Squad]] to lose a primary. *[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[China at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[China]] wins their first [[Olympic medal|gold medal]] in [[Artistic swimming at the 2024 Summer Olympics|artistic swimming]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/olympics/artistic-swimming-china-win-gold-team-event-2024-08-07/ (Reuters)]

**[[India at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[India]]n wrestler [[Vinesh Phogat]] is disqualified from the final of the [[Wrestling at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's freestyle 50 kg|Women's freestyle 50 kg]] event for being above the stipulated weight during the weigh-in on the morning of the finals, eliminating her from the medal competition and relegating her to last place in the classification.
